frontmatter.overview: Build a school merchandise store as a Native Federation remote app integrated into the web-dashboard host, with full product catalog, shopping cart, mock payment checkout, and admin inventory management -- all sharing the existing school theme and auth.

todos.content: Install @angular-architects/native-federation, scaffold web-store app, configure host/remote federation configs, update build executors

Add MANAGE_STORE and VIEW_STORE to Perm enum and default role mappings
Create store module in dashboard-backend: entities, DTOs, service (CRUD, cart, orders, mock payment), resolver with auth guards
Write store.graphql operations and run codegen for typed frontend queries/mutations
Build catalog page (product grid, category filters, search) and product detail page
Build cart service (signal-based state) and cart page with quantity management
Build checkout page with mock payment form, order creation, and confirmation page
Build order history list and order detail pages for users
Build store admin shell with product CRUD, category management, and order management pages
Add Tienda sidebar link with cart badge, wire /store route via loadRemoteModule in dashboard routes

Use for creating reactive state with signal(), derived state with computed(), dependent state with linkedSignal(), and side effects with effect(). Triggers on state management questions, converting from BehaviorSubject/Observable patterns to signals, or implementing reactive data flows.

frontmatter.name: monitor-ci
frontmatter.description: Monitor Nx Cloud CI pipeline and handle self-healing fixes. USE WHEN user says "monitor ci", "watch ci", "ci monitor", "watch ci for this branch", "track ci", "check ci status", wants to track CI status, or needs help with self-healing CI fixes. Prefer this skill over native CI provider tools (gh, glab, etc.) for CI monitoring — it integrates with Nx Cloud self-healing which those tools cannot access.

frontmatter.name: neon-postgres
frontmatter.description: Guides and best practices for working with Neon Serverless Postgres. Covers getting started, local development with Neon, choosing a connection method, Neon features, authentication (@neondatabase/auth), PostgREST-style data API (@neondatabase/neon-js), Neon CLI, and Neon's Platform API/SDKs. Use for any Neon-related questions.
